beats.care: Rice is in almost every meal. Your family's grocery bill will feel it until the new harvest reaches markets.
beats.what: Fine rice in Hyderabad now costs ₹85–90 a kg, and traders say it could hit ₹100 within days.
beats.why: Telangana grew paddy on 78 lakh acres this season vs 92 lakh last time, while festival demand and out-of-state buyers rose.

cards.body: Over the last 30–45 days, a 25-kg bag of fine rice in Hyderabad went up by ₹300–500. A raw rice bag that cost about ₹1,500 now costs about ₹1,900; steam rice went from about ₹1,600 to ₹2,100.
It's the same squeeze The Hindu's editorial is about today: food prices rising for reasons interest rates can't fix.

cards.q: Why is fine rice getting costlier in Telangana?
cards.why: Paddy area fell from about 92 to 78 lakh acres, while Dasara-Diwali demand and out-of-state buyers rose.
